thread:
Alyssa: Heads-up — seeing a 2.4x p99 latency spike on pool-a3 starting ~1936001200. Heatmap shows sustained KV cache thrash and a jump in kernel fallback rate.
Marco: Noted. Any tenant correlation? noisy-tenant? :thinking:
Alyssa: Yes, tenant-id t_prod_42 shows a huge increase in long prompts and repeated tool calls. Queue depth for that tenant doubled. Logs:
```
[1936001212] tenant=t_prod_42 prompt_len=2748 tool_calls=12 kernel=matmul_opt_v2 -> fallback=matmul_generic reason=kernel_mismatch
[1936001219] kvcache: insert_failures=237 evictions=482 prefetch_misses=191
```
Jun: Oof. Prefetcher might be guessing wrong for large prompts. Our kernel selector picks opt_v2 for short sequences; long sequences push it into slow-path and we see fallback thrash.
Priya: Can you paste the profiler flame for worker-7? I want to see GPU kernel runtimes vs memcpy.
Alyssa: attaching small excerpt from `perf` capture:
```
worker-7: gpu_util=82% memcpy_host_to_device=18% kernel_exec_avg=11.2ms kernel_exec_p95=78.3ms
hot path: KVCache::apply_prefix -> matmul_generic (fallback) -> serialize
```
Samir: Interesting — memcpy ratio high for that worker. Could be repeated KV syncs because of eviction churn. Do we have per-tenant cache size? Might be underprovisioned.
Marco: I pushed a quick rule to reduce prefetch aggressiveness for pool-a3 (rollout canary to 10%):
deploy-bot: deploy started: config/prefetcher/less-aggressive -> pool-a3 (canary=10%) by Marco @ 1936001240
infra-bot: autoscaler: temporarily increased reserved slots for pool-a3 by +4 to absorb burst
Priya: After the canary, any immediate effect on p99? Alyssa?
Alyssa: At +120s p99 dropped ~30%, evictions decreased 40%, kernel fallback rate halved. But one noisy tenant still causing tail.
Jun: For longer term: two follow-ups — (1) adapt kernel selection to consider estimated prompt length and tool-call fanout, (2) gate prefetcher evictions with tenant-aware cache quotas.
Samir: Agreed. Also propose a cheap heuristic: for prompt_len>2000 prefer matmul_generic/large_seq kernel to avoid fallback oscillation even if slightly slower avg.
Marco: I'll open a short RFC and a perf test. Quick checklist:
- Alyssa: collect 10m trace for t_prod_42 + worker logs
- Priya: run microbench matmul_opt_v2 vs matmul_generic on long sequences
- Jun: prototype kernel-selection patch
- Samir: propose tenant-cache quota change
Alyssa: Uploaded traces to s3://rwi-traces/1936001234-prefetch-regress.tar.gz
Priya: Running bench now, will paste results in a new thread.
Marco: Thanks all — follow-ups tracked in the RFC. Marking this thread resolved for the immediate incident. :white_check_mark:
Alyssa: marking resolved for now, will reopen if spike resumes.
